scope: Exploratory paired CODE processing attitude, not independent physical attitude or code-response calibration.

conventions.ray_comparison: Fixed radial-calibration receiver clock; geometric differences separate from full recalibration
conventions.controls: 60 s attitude thinning and body-Z-only offset, each recalibrated/refitted; omitted native nodes
unresolved: directional code antenna response and receiver biases
